headline: Indian Markets Rally On Strong FII Inflows And Easing Oil Prices Amid Asian Global Sell-Off

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) pumped Rs 14,975 crore into domestic shares, driving strong market gains.
Easier crude oil prices provided relief to Indian equities and boosted investor sentiment.
Strong global buying momentum pushed Sensex and Nifty higher by over 3% in recent sessions.
Global equities face volatility as Asian markets drop amid a deepening AI stock sell-off.
whatHappening: Sensex surged by up to 2,000 points and Nifty crossed 24,300–24,500 levels in recent trading.
Adani Ports announced an acquisition of Dutch tank storage operator Evos for €2.56 billion.
Asian indices like Nikkei entered a bear market while Kospi crashed 9% due to global tech slump.
US bond yields eased as oil prices stabilized and mortgage rates fell to 7.18%.
summary:
Indian stock markets logged strong recent gains supported by heavy foreign institutional inflows and easing crude oil prices.
However, global market headwinds persist as Asian stocks crash following a deepened sell-off in US technology and AI sectors.
Adani Ports remains in focus following its major €2.56 billion acquisition deal in Europe.
